text:
```yaml
name: clang static analyzer

on:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  clang-analyzer:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: rsyslog/rsyslog_dev_base_ubuntu:24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for code changes
        id: code_changes
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v46
        with:
          files: |
            **/*.c
            **/*.h
            grammar/lexer.l
            grammar/grammar.y

      - name: Install clang static analyzer
        if: steps.code_changes.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          apt-get update
          apt-get install -y clang-tools

      - name: Run clang static analyzer
        if: steps.code_changes.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake .. -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang
          scan-build -o scan-report make -j$(nproc)

      - name: Upload scan-build report
        if: steps.code_changes.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: scan-build-report
          path: build/scan-report
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Log artifact URL
        if: steps.code_changes.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Scan-build HTML report available at:"
          echo "https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}/artifacts/*"
```
